title: Comparative efficacy of intravitreal aflibercept biosimilar QL1207 versus reference aflibercept in the treatment of diabetic macular edema

groups.description: Treatment-naive DME eyes treated with reference aflibercept, three monthly loading doses then PRN
Treatment-naive DME eyes treated with the aflibercept biosimilar QL1207, three monthly loading doses then PRN, matched to the aflibercept group on baseline characteristics

exclusions.what: tab1 BCVA (LogMAR) rows R2 and R4 (both groups, baseline to 12 months)
exclusions.reason: Enrolment required complete clinical records and all patients completed a minimum follow-up of 12 months, the last tabulated visit (Methods, Abstract): a complete-case set; the article does not state that no treated eye was left out. No record.

notes: Retrospective comparison of reference aflibercept and its biosimilar QL1207 in routine care (both control).
QL1207 eyes were matched to aflibercept eyes on baseline characteristics (age, baseline BCVA, CRT, FAZ, vessel density); baseline matching is not post-baseline selection.
BCVA in logMAR (table label and Methods); CRT and OCT angiography parameters are not extracted.
